categories.main_business_segments: Mega-info Media Co., Ltd. primarily operates in high-speed rail digital media and urban commercial district digital media advertising. The company develops, operates, and publishes advertisements using digital media resources in railway passenger stations, including digital screen machines, TV video machines, and LED large screens. It also engages in outdoor naked-eye 3D high-definition large screen media in major city commercial areas.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes digital media technology integrating digital screen machines, TV video machines, and LED large screens networked via an information system platform for remote digital control and one-click advertisement publishing. It employs advanced display technologies such as naked-eye 3D, frame refresh, real dynamic image restoration, and edge enhancement. AI technologies are deeply integrated into digital content creation, including original design, scene construction, 3D engineering, and image processing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Mega-info Media serves major brand advertisers across industries including food and beverage, home building materials, alcohol, internet, automotive, luxury goods, cosmetics, and fashion. Key clients include JD.com, Qipai, Moutai Group, Pulse, Nongfu Spring, Gucci, Celine, Burberry, BV, Huawei, Xiaomi, Coca-Cola, and Pepsi. The company targets high-speed rail passengers and urban commercial district consumers, leveraging large-scale audience reach in these venues.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates a nationwide high-speed rail digital media network covering 30 provincial-level administrative regions in China, including economically developed areas such as the Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, Bohai Rim, and Southeast Coast. It also has urban commercial district media in core cities like Guangzhou, Taiyuan, Guiyang, Chengdu, Beijing, and Shenzhen. The network includes 529 signed railway passenger stations and 495 operational stations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Mega-info Media operates primarily in the midstream segment of the advertising supply chain as a digital media resource developer and operator. It procures media resources and digital media equipment, installs and manages digital media networks, and sells advertising space directly to advertisers and agencies. It does not manufacture hardware but manages media assets and advertising services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on expanding and upgrading its high-speed rail digital media network and urban commercial district digital outdoor media, especially leveraging naked-eye 3D technology. It invests in digital media operation system upgrades and AI-driven digital content creation. Strategic priorities include enhancing media resource quality, expanding coverage, deepening local market sales teams, and exploring new technologies such as AR, VR, and AI to enrich interactive digital media experiences.
categories.revenue_model: Mega-info Media generates revenue exclusively from advertising publishing services on its digital media platforms. It signs medium- to long-term agreements with railway bureaus for media resource usage and sells advertising slots to clients based on station, screen, or package pricing. Revenue is recognized monthly based on completed advertisement delivery according to contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading national operator in the high-speed rail digital media advertising sector, with one of the broadest media resource coverages in China. The industry comprises national, regional, and small-scale media operators. Mega-info Media holds a high barrier to entry due to its extensive network and exclusive agreements with all 18 railway bureau groups. It also leads in urban commercial district digital outdoor media with innovative naked-eye 3D displays.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Mega-info Media reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 670.4 million, a 12.26% increase from 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 75.6 million, a 43.64% decrease year-over-year. The company’s total assets were about RMB 4.42 billion with net assets of RMB 3.04 billion. It maintains a stable growth trajectory with ongoing investments in media network expansion and technology upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers unique value through its extensive nationwide high-speed rail digital media network and innovative urban commercial district naked-eye 3D large screens, providing advertisers with high-impact, immersive, and precise audience targeting. Its digitalized remote control platform enables flexible, personalized, and efficient advertisement delivery. The integration of AI in content creation and advanced display technologies differentiates its offerings, enhancing brand visibility and engagement in premium transportation and commercial venues.
